field_data: 23 August 2014 Z7 field recordings. Event identifiers are the sequential Iceland100 workshop IDs. Starting catalogue Ágústsdóttir et al. (2019), Data Set S1, https://doi.org/10.1029/2018JB016010. Waveform network https://doi.org/10.7914/SN/Z7_2010.
graph_export: export_teaching_edges.jl reconstructs the exact classroom geometry graph from the completed prelocation shift. The verified slice contains 724 geometry edges, 409 contributing pairs and 4815 supported station–phase rows.
drawing: theory_figures.py recreates all original figures from the classroom inputs and reference outputs. The incidence/Huber/shared-ray figures are mathematical illustrations. Counts, times, topology, field locations and errors in all other original figures are real field-workshop products. The Cahuilla plots reproduce the preprint figure cited above.
